definitions.explanation: Mountains in the snowy season, and climbing them, which needs special skills and equipment and carries a high risk of avalanches and exposure.

examples.japanese: {冬山|ふゆやま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
{冬山|ふゆやま}⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I prepare for a winter climb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧な⟦{装備|そうび}→装備：14103_soubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧まま{冬山|ふゆやま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}り→入る：00494_hairu⟧、⟦{遭難|そうなん}→遭難：09510_sounan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Every year some people go into the winter mountains without enough equipment and get lost.

notes:
Most often heard in warnings and news about mountain accidents. Mountains in summer are {夏山|なつやま}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冬山|ふゆやま}⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧: winter mountaineering
- {冬山|ふゆやま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遭難|そうなん}→遭難：09510_sounan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get lost or stranded on a winter mountain
- {冬山|ふゆやま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{装備|そうび}→装備：14103_soubi⟧: winter-climbing gear
